hero.title: On Time Every Time.
hero.description: Chauffeur travel, special occasions and employee transport across Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Pune.

customerJourneys.title: Executive & VIP Travel
customerJourneys.tagline: Punctual airport arrivals, board meeting itineraries, and executive mobility.
customerJourneys.description: Tailored for senior executives, visiting delegations, and high-profile travellers demanding confidentiality, pristine cabins, and route precision across Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Pune.
customerJourneys.imageAlt: Executive luxury cabin with refined leather seating

customerJourneys.title: Weddings & Private Occasions
customerJourneys.tagline: Family convoys, couple arrivals, and coordinated guest transfers.
customerJourneys.description: Seamless multi-vehicle logistics for destination weddings, family celebrations, and gala events with dedicated route coordination connecting hotels, ceremony venues, and airports.
customerJourneys.imageAlt: Premium vehicle convoy prepared for special occasions

customerJourneys.title: Corporate Employee Transport
customerJourneys.tagline: Daily shift rosters, corridor routing, and reliable employee shuttles.
customerJourneys.description: Managed employee commute solutions configured around shift rosters, attendance punctuality, and route corridors with 22 and 44-seater group shuttles across tech corridors.
customerJourneys.imageAlt: Modern 22 and 44-seater corporate employee commuter coach

about.title: Transport for the people you move.
about.description: Victor Mobility provides employee transportation, bus and shuttle transport, event travel, airport transfers, chauffeur services and vehicle rentals. Our India website brings together the services and fleet categories you can discuss with our team.
about.cta: Tell us about your transport requirement.

services.title: Employee Transportation
services.shortDescription: Transport for daily employee travel and workplace shuttles.
services.description: Discuss your employee commute and shuttle requirements with Victor. Share your operating locations, shift timings and approximate passenger numbers so the team can plan a suitable transport arrangement.

services.title: Bus & Shuttle Transport
services.shortDescription: Group transport for workplaces, venues and scheduled travel.
services.description: Explore bus and shuttle options for moving groups between offices, pickup points and event venues. Tell the team your route, schedule and expected passenger count to discuss an appropriate vehicle category.

services.title: Event Transportation
services.shortDescription: Vehicle arrangements for conferences, celebrations and event guests.
services.description: Coordinate your event travel requirements with Victor, from guest arrivals and departures to group and VIP transfers. Share event dates, locations and the approximate number of passengers.

services.title: Airport Transfers
services.shortDescription: Pickup and drop-off arrangements for airport journeys.
services.description: Arrange transport to or from the airport. Share your pickup and drop-off locations, travel date and time, passenger count and luggage requirements so the team can discuss a suitable option.

services.title: Chauffeur & Luxury Travel
services.shortDescription: Chauffeur-driven travel for business and special occasions.
services.description: Discuss executive, luxury and limousine transport for business trips, events and special occasions. Ask the team to confirm suitable vehicle options for your location, dates and requirements.
services.source: Brochure page 3 and current user service description

services.title: Rent-A-Car
services.shortDescription: Vehicle rental enquiries for your travel plans.
services.description: Enquire about vehicle rental and self-drive options listed in Victor's brochure. Share your location, rental dates and preferred category; the team will confirm applicable availability, terms and requirements.

faqs.question: What types of transportation can I enquire about?
faqs.answer: Employee transportation, bus and shuttle transport, event travel, airport transfers, chauffeur and luxury travel, and vehicle rentals.

faqs.question: Which India locations are listed?
faqs.answer: The brochure lists Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Pune as primary India operating cities. For another location, share your requirement with the team.

faqs.question: How do I request a quote?
faqs.answer: Choose a service and share your city and travel requirements. You can continue on WhatsApp to send your enquiry or call the team.

faqs.question: Does sending an enquiry confirm my booking?
faqs.answer: No. The team will discuss your requirements and confirm availability and arrangements with you.
